title: Remove Duplicate Characters
description: Given a string, remove duplicate characters while preserving the original order of the first occurrence of each character.
input: A string from which duplicate characters need to be removed.
output: A string containing only the first occurrence of each character, with the original order preserved.

examples.explanation: Repeated characters are removed while the first occurrence of each character remains in its original position.
The second occurrence of 'l' is removed while the first occurrence is preserved.
The first occurrences of 'b', 'a', and 'n' are preserved and subsequent duplicates are removed.
There are no duplicate characters, so the string remains unchanged.

constraints: The input must be a valid string.

approaches.name: Using Set
approaches.description: Traverse the string from left to right and use a Set to keep track of characters that have already been encountered. Add a character to the result only when it has not appeared before.
approaches.whenToUse: Use when duplicate characters need to be removed efficiently while preserving the order of their first occurrence.

interviewTips: Understand why a Set is useful for tracking characters that have already appeared.
Make sure the original order of the first occurrence is preserved.
Know the difference between removing duplicates and sorting unique characters.
Be prepared to explain the time and space complexity.
